rv.q: This is a work of rare grace, truth and beauty and is undoubtedly this century’s answer to Angels in America — and then some.
This epic might be firmly set in 2015, but it's an elegy that's teeming with a whole century of lost history – and lost lives.
I cannot remember the last time I so wanted an interval to end so I could re-engage with characters and their story.

It has to, if anything, to build dramatic tension and then release it. And there aren’t too many of those ‘wow’ moments, making each of them suitably substantial.rnrnIt does spin an interesting yarn. Sometimes the set is sparse; other times it is clearer where exactly a scene is.
It's a vast and ambitious undertaking, and it's absolutely transcendent.
